programme.title: Torvill & Dean: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Jayne Torvill and Christopher Dean reflect candidly on a remarkable 50-year career on ice as this fly-on-the-wall documentary captures every moment throughout their final UK and Australia tour and the prospect of an emotional 'Last Dance' - our cameras follow the Olympic legends behind-the-scenes throughout their final year as performers, from their preparations and final television performance on Dancing on Ice to the early gruelling training sessions and first rehearsals in Scotland, the iconic first show of the live tour in London, and then throughout the next energy-sapping four months as the duo tour with the support of an ensemble cast of world-class skaters, a unique show that tells their life story from their first meeting to their final-ever performance. There is every chance the wheels may come off, and this film captures the raw emotion of life on the road.

Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - if a player answers correctly, they remain in the Hot Seat and continue up the Money Ladder, but if they get a question wrong, they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place. Each player is given one Pass - a chance to pass the question on to the next player - but in doing so forfeit their place in the Hot Seat and risk not making it back there later on. Only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, and the player taking on that question must answer it correctly to take home the cash.

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: At Jamie's final game for Leicester City, he scores his 200th goal for the club - it's a fairytale ending to one of the greatest underdog stories in sporting history. But he's not done with football yet, and the search for his new club begins. As speculation mounts, the Vardys consider offers from clubs all wanting to sign the 38-year-old striker. But none are in England, which forces the family to consider: would they go with Jamie, or stay at home? On deadline day, there is last-minute chaos as Jamie decides between two top clubs, one in Holland and the other in Italy. At the eleventh hour, he takes the Italian job. The Vardys are going to Italy! Determined to stay together as a family unit, Becky flies to Italy to find a house and schools for the kids - but in rainy Milan, nothing goes to plan.

programme.title: Torvill & Dean: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Jayne Torvill and Christopher Dean reflect candidly on a remarkable 50-year career on ice as this fly-on-the-wall documentary captures every moment throughout their final UK and Australia tour and the prospect of an emotional 'Last Dance' - our cameras follow the Olympic legends behind-the-scenes throughout their final year as performers, from their preparations and final television performance on Dancing on Ice to the early gruelling training sessions and first rehearsals in Scotland, the iconic first show of the live tour in London, and then throughout the next energy-sapping four months as the duo tour with the support of an ensemble cast of world-class skaters, a unique show that tells their life story from their first meeting to their final-ever performance. There is every chance the wheels may come off, and this film captures the raw emotion of life on the road.

programme.title: Millionaire Hot Seat
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson hosts the exciting and fast-paced quiz where each episode sees six hopefuls compete for a one-million-pound prize - however, only one player can take their place in the Hot Seat at a time and answer multiple-choice questions to work their way up the Money Ladder. Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - if a player answers correctly, they remain in the Hot Seat and continue up the Money Ladder, but if they get a question wrong, they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place. Each player is given one Pass - a chance to pass the question on to the next player - but in doing so forfeit their place in the Hot Seat and risk not making it back there later on. Only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, and the player taking on that question must answer it correctly to take home the cash.

Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - if a player answers correctly, they remain in the Hot Seat and continue up the Money Ladder, but if they get a question wrong, they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place. Only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, and the player taking on that question must answer it correctly to take home the cash.

programme.title: Torvill & Dean: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Jayne Torvill and Christopher Dean reflect candidly on a remarkable 50-year career on ice as this fly-on-the-wall documentary captures every moment throughout their final UK and Australia tour and the prospect of an emotional 'Last Dance' - our cameras follow the Olympic legends behind-the-scenes throughout their final year as performers, from their preparations and final television performance on Dancing on Ice to the early gruelling training sessions and first rehearsals in Scotland, the iconic first show of the live tour in London, and then throughout the next energy-sapping four months as the duo tour with the support of an ensemble cast of world-class skaters, a unique show that tells their life story from their first meeting to their final-ever performance. There is every chance the wheels may come off, and this film captures the raw emotion of life on the road.

After news breaks that Jeanine Long has taken her own life, evidence comes to light exonerating her for the murder of 15-year-old Abigail Mantel 11 years earlier. Jeanie had always insisted on her innocence but no-one - including her own family - believed her. Vera sets out to solve the mystery of Abigail's death, and she and her team delve into the secrets and lies of a small community which is still feeling the repercussions of the killing. programme.title: King Rat
programme.desc: 1965. War. Director: Bryan Forbes. Stars George Segal, Tom Courtenay & James Fox. A U.S. corporal operates a number of lucrative rackets within a WWII POW camp to have control and thrive in camp. [S]

programme.title: Honey West
programme.desc: 1965. Come To Me, My Litigation Baby! Classic crime series produced by Aaron Spelling and stars Anne Francis. Honey investigates a man who claims he was paralysed by falling down the stairs.

programme.title: Danger UXB
programme.desc: Dead Man's Shoes. 1979. Stars Anthony Andrews, Marjie Lawrence & Deborah Watling. Second Lieutenant Brian Ash joins his new regiment only to find that they are assigned to bomb disposal.

programme.title: The Adventures of Jim Bowie
programme.desc: Monsieur Francois. 1956. Stars Scott Forbes, Paul Playdon & Roger Til. Jim Bowie comes to the aid of a young French boy and his aunt who are being victimised by confidence tricksters. [S]

programme.title: Subway in the Sky
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Directed by Muriel Box. Starring Hildegard Knef, Katherine Kath & Van Johnson. A military doctor is falsely accused of dealing illegal drugs. Can he prove his innocence? [S]

programme.title: The Madame Gambles
programme.desc: 1951. Comedy. The owner of a dress shop gambles the shop away to her bookie who inherits, not only the shop, but the manager. Directed by Maclean Rogers. Starring Richard Hearne and Petula Clark. [S]

programme.title: Tread Softly
programme.desc: 1952. Crime. Directed by David MacDonald. Stars Frances Day, Patricia Dainton & John Bentley. The star of a musical walks out before curtain up, but the show must go on, in a 'Haunted Theatre'. [S]

programme.title: Star Performance
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Directed by Peter Godfrey. Stars David Niven, Gloria Talbott & Barbara Billingsley. A successful commercial artist is enticed away from his lucrative career by a young model. [S]

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Two Poisons. 1964. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Charles Morgan. Mary Briggs has just buried her husband to be with her lover. Sergeant Cork recieves a hint about foul play. [S]

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Bear. 1958. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. When his son joins Tell's group and refuses to return home, the Bear, swears to seek revenge on Tell and his followers. [S]

programme.title: The Gentle Sex
programme.desc: 1943. Drama. Directed by Leslie Howard. Stars Joan Gates, Jean Gillie, Lilli Palmer, Rosamund John & Joan Greenwood. During WW2, seven women find themselves in the Auxiliary Territorial Services. [S]

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Sing and dance along to the Johnny Otis Band as they perform the 1958 hit ''Willie and the Hand Jive''.

programme.title: That Beryl Marston!
programme.desc: Noel - Oh 'Ell. 1981. Comedy. Stars Julia McKenzie, Gareth Hunt & Jonathon Morris. Georgie tries to put a brave face on for Christmas as Auntie Vera and Uncle Fred arrive. [S] (S1, E06)

programme.title: Mad Mel and Mister Gibson
programme.desc: 2021. The rise, fall and resurrection of Mel Gibson, one of the most successful but also controversial Hollywood stars. From Mad Max to The Passion of the Christ, from Lethal Weapon to Braveheart.

programme.title: Band of Thieves
programme.desc: 1962. Musical Comedy with Acker Bilk, Jimmy Thompson, Jennifer Jayne, Geoffrey Sumner & Maudie Edwards. One of the truly great Trad' Jazz films of all time. [S]

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: Canoomba Incident. 1961. Stars Peter Graves, Anthony Wickert & Janette Craig. Canoomba is empty of men after a gold strike. Things get strange after Cobb is robbed by a what appears to be a girl. [S]

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Brain-Killer Affair. 1965. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Leo G. Carroll. Thrush poisons Waverly, with plans to subject him to a procedure that affects the brain. [S]

programme.title: The Mind of Mr. J. G. Reeder
programme.desc: 1971. Man With A Strange Tattoo. Stars Hugh Burden, Willoughby Goddard & Gillian Lewis. An intruder is shot and killed by Lady Rothbard, a member of a distinguished family from India. [S]

programme.title: The Racing Game
programme.desc: Trackdown. 1979. Stars Mike Gwilym, Mick Ford & Leslie Sands. When Sid and Chico investigate why a winning horse keeps losing, they uncover blackmail and murder. [S]

programme.title: Sapphire
programme.desc: 1959. Murder mystery. Directed by Basil Dearden and stars Nigel Patrick, Yvonne Mitchell and Michael Craig. Superintendent Robert Hazard investigates a murder, which could be racially motivated. [S]

programme.title: Fortean TV
programme.desc: 1997. Hosted by Reverend Lionel Fanthorpe. Swim with miracle fish, hunt for a vampire-like creature in Puerto Rico and cut deep into the mystery of the mermaid.

programme.title: Cream Farewell Concert
programme.desc: British super group Cream captured live at the Royal Albert Hall in 1968. Tracks include 'Sunshine of Your Love', 'White Room', 'Politician' and many more. [S]

programme.title: Millionaire Hot Seat
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson hosts the exciting and fast-paced quiz where each episode sees six hopefuls compete for a one-million-pound prize - however, only one player can take their place in the Hot Seat at a time and answer multiple-choice questions to work their way up the Money Ladder. Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - if a player answers correctly, they remain in the Hot Seat and continue up the Money Ladder, but if they get a question wrong, they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place. Each player is given one Pass - a chance to pass the question on to the next player - but in doing so forfeit their place in the Hot Seat and risk not making it back there later on. Only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, and the player taking on that question must answer it correctly to take home the cash.

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: At Jamie's final game for Leicester City, he scores his 200th goal for the club - it's a fairytale ending to one of the greatest underdog stories in sporting history. But he's not done with football yet, and the search for his new club begins. As speculation mounts, the Vardys consider offers from clubs all wanting to sign the 38-year-old striker. But none are in England, which forces the family to consider: would they go with Jamie, or stay at home? On deadline day, there is last-minute chaos as Jamie decides between two top clubs, one in Holland and the other in Italy. At the eleventh hour, he takes the Italian job. The Vardys are going to Italy! Determined to stay together as a family unit, Becky flies to Italy to find a house and schools for the kids - but in rainy Milan, nothing goes to plan.

programme.title: Millionaire Hot Seat
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson hosts the exciting and fast-paced quiz where each episode sees six hopefuls compete for a one-million-pound prize - however, only one player can take their place in the Hot Seat at a time and answer multiple-choice questions to work their way up the Money Ladder. Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - if a player answers correctly, they remain in the Hot Seat and continue up the Money Ladder, but if they get a question wrong, they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place. Each player is given one Pass - a chance to pass the question on to the next player - but in doing so forfeit their place in the Hot Seat and risk not making it back there later on. Only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, and the player taking on that question must answer it correctly to take home the cash.
